Subject: Acme procurement & security gating: next steps

Hi Jordan / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the call earlier appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call recap / asks
- Procurement path: Jordan indicated ACME prefers a PO-based flow if possible (vs card). Please confirm whether this is your final preference and if you have a standard PO template.
- Marketplace: you asked about whether Redwood supports billing via cloud marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP). Short answer: yes we can provide an AMI/marketplace listing or direct invoice; we can discuss which is faster for your procurement.
- Security gating: attached is our SOC 2 summary and the current DPA (v3). You requested full SOC 2 report access we typically share the full report under an NDA or as part of vendor onboarding.

Proposed next steps
1) Jordan/procurement: confirm preferred billing instrument (PO vs card vs marketplace) and attach PO template if PO.
2) We will: a) share vendor setup info (W-9, vendor form), b) prepare DocuSign for DPA, c) route to our finance for PO acceptance and vendor setup.
3) Target timeline: if PO + DPA executed this week, estimated vendor setup and billing enablement ~5-10 business days. If marketplace preferred, timeline may vary.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, Redwood_DPA_v3.docx

If helpful I can loop in our finance lead (lauren) to own vendor setup and nikhil to drive contract execution.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
